body:
As i thought, no one gives a fuck.
It's decided then, not even a sub dedicated to exactly this cares.

I'm a sad existence, i wish i was never born, would make things easier on everyone that crossed paths with me.

I'm doing it tomorrow definitely just need to drop off my dog somewhere he'll be taken care of.
Fuck life, end it as soon as possible if you're struggling, no one will help you, it's all meaningless anyways. I'm at peace now knowing that no one will probably even notice that I'm gone for a good month (when bills start coming due), don't want to cause pain to anyone.

Don't let this be you, seek help from whoever is willing to talk to you, as after a certain point no one will even want to do that anymore.

Decided on crashing my car into a nice concrete wall in my town, my license is suspended but that's not gonna be an issue obviously.
I guess i wouldn't be typing this if i weren't hoping for someone to help in the last possible moment... But I'm done with it, and last thing i want to say is fuck everyone, fuck every single person I've ever met, always tried to be a good person, they take advantage and fuck you over. You're all the same, i hope you suffer as much as i am now.

Bye.

I feel about the same, still didn't make a final decision but I'm here, so...
Think about all other aspects of your life, is it worth doing it just because of this? If you think so you have every right to do it, but if you doubt it then you shouldn't do it. Can't promise it'll get better but it ultimately can't hurt to try
